label: Real-Time VAT & E-Invoicing Readiness
description: Assess readiness for continuous/real-time VAT reporting and structured e-invoicing. Covers the EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) package (adopted 11 Mar 2025 as Directive (EU) 2025/516; reporting obligations apply from 2030), national digital reporting and e-invoicing mandates (Italy SdI, France, Poland KSeF, Spain SII/Verifactu), transaction-level VAT determination, and the data architecture and controls needed for near-real-time compliance.

claudeKnowledge.description: EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) package — adopted by the Council on 11 Mar 2025 as Council Directive (EU) 2025/516, Council Regulation (EU) 2025/517 and Council Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/518 (originating from COM/2022/701, 703, 704; political agreement 5 Nov 2024), amending Directive 2006/112/EC, with staggered application dates to 2035; Directive 2006/112/EC (the VAT Directive); EN 16931 European e-invoicing standard; Italy Sistema di Interscambio (SdI) + FatturaPA; France e-invoicing/e-reporting reform (Article 153 LF 2020, Factur-X, PPF/PDP model); Poland KSeF / FA(3) schema; Spain SII + Verifactu (RD 1007/2023); national tax authority technical specifications and onboarding guides; ISO 20022; Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 + Peppol PINT

guidedInputs.label: Known issues or concerns
guidedInputs.description: Describe current pain points, upcoming go-live dates, prior audit findings, or specific transaction types that worry you.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Italy SdI rejections (code 00400 nature/rate mismatch) running at ~6%; French e-reporting go-live approaching with no PDP selected; intra-EU triangulation flows lack clean party VAT IDs; reduced-rate determination for mixed supplies is manual...

exampleInput: We are a mid-size manufacturer headquartered in Sweden with subsidiaries in Italy, France and Poland and B2B sales across the EU. We run SAP ECC (migrating to S/4HANA in 2027) with a bolt-on tax engine for some flows but manual VAT coding for others. Italy is already live on SdI but we see periodic rejections; France's mandate is approaching and we have not selected a PDP; Poland KSeF go-live is on our radar. Assess our readiness for continuous/real-time VAT reporting and structured e-invoicing across these jurisdictions and against the EU ViDA proposal. Focus on transaction-level VAT determination, the quality of our EN 16931 invoice data and master data, and the controls/reconciliation architecture we need for near-real-time compliance. Known weak spots: triangulation and intra-Community supply flows often have missing or unvalidated counterparty VAT numbers, and reduced-rate determination on mixed supplies is done manually by the AP team.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Italy SdI live but periodic rejections; France PDP not yet selected with the mandate approaching; Poland KSeF on the roadmap. Intra-Community supply and triangulation flows often have missing/unvalidated counterparty VAT numbers (no VIES check at order entry). Reduced-rate determination on mixed supplies is manual. SAP ECC today, S/4HANA migration planned 2027.
